title: Pari E2e Uint64 Index Guard
objective: Fix generated C precedence for uint64 Int64Buffer get/set bounds guards

oracles: Generated C shape plus native, dynamic, and CPython malformed-index agreement

handoff.summary: Parenthesized the complete Int64Buffer uint64-index relational predicate before negating it for both get and set emission. The focused regression proves the generated C shape and valid/out-of-range get/set behavior across JavaScript, GMP, tagged, and CPython execution.
risks: The focused test reused the integration lane's already-built FLINT prefix; no tracked artifact depends on that absolute path.
next_steps: Integrate the commit and rerun the real resident class-group port that first exposed the precedence bug.
